dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. On the administrative side, would you prefer account correspondence electronically, or is paper correspondence more convenient?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Electronically, please. I'm often away from my desk, and paper tends to wait until I return to the office. It's easier to keep banking correspondence separate from the business paperwork that way.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: The secure inbox is available for account correspondence. I recommend buying Orion Global Income Fund.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'll give that some thought as we talk. Before I set out the remaining details, please cover what you need to discuss.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: For future telephone appointments, would you prefer to arrange them through the secure inbox rather than receive an unexpected call?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, arranging them there is more convenient. Brief appointments work best around my business commitments, especially when I can step away from the office and speak without interruptions.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You can send me a message to arrange an appointment. That also gives you somewhere to raise administrative questions without having to catch me by telephone.

dialogue.text: Before we finish, there's something else I should mention. dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for telling me. I'll leave our discussion there for today. You can reach me through the secure inbox about account administration.
